statement.p: Given that \small{f(9) = -1} and \small{f'(9) = 1}, find an equation for the tangent line to the graph of \small{y = f(x)} at \small{x = 9}.

static.solution:
\small{f'(9) = 1}, the slope of the tangent line at \small{x = 9} is \small{1}. Since \small{f(9) = -1}, the tangent line contains the point \small{(9,-1)}.
Therefore, the equation of the tangent line to \small{f(x)} at \small{x = 9} is \small{y + 1 = 1(x - 9)}, or \small{y = 1 x - 10}.
